original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳艾滋病委员会警告：HIV污名化阻碍检测、预防与治疗
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳艾滋病委员会（GAC）警告称，围绕HIV的污名化正在阻碍人们获取预防、检测、治疗和支持服务。委员会总干事Kharmacelle Prosper Akanbong博士表示，将HIV感染自动等同于滥交的误解持续影响着病毒携带者所受的对待。他称这类观念既不公正，也削弱了相关防治努力。

key_facts.fact: 加纳艾滋病委员会警告HIV污名化阻碍人们获取预防、检测、治疗和支持服务
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Stigma surrounding HIV is discouraging people from accessing prevention, testing, treatment and support services, the Ghana AIDS Commission (GAC) has warned.

key_facts.fact: 委员会总干事称将HIV感染等同于滥交的误解影响病毒携带者所受对待
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General of the Commission, Dr Kharmacelle Prosper Akanbong, said misconceptions linking HIV infection automatically to promiscuity continue to influence how people living with the virus are treated.

key_facts.fact: 总干事在JoyNews节目上表示此类观念不公正并削弱防治努力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Speaking on Konsulting Room 5 on JoyNews, Dr Akanbong said such perceptions were not only unfair but were also undermining efforts
